messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Ask ONE distinguishing question (offering the three options is best), confirm H-302 (2250 Main St, near Oak), transfer both.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"B-4471","default_store":"B-4471","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: find_stores({"query":"Harbor Main Lakeview"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-301","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St Downtown","address":"120 Main St, Lakeview, MI (near 1st Ave)"},{"store_id":"H-302","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St University","address":"2250 Main St, Lake...)
    (agent system action #7: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Jamal Carter"}) -> success {"patient":"Jamal Carter","prescriptions":[]})
[#9] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then help you transfer those prescriptions. I don't see any active prescriptions on file for you at Harbor Pharmacy. Your albuterol and sertraline are at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, which is outside our system. To transfer them to Harbor, the receiving Harbor store needs to request them from Brightway. Which Harbor location on Main Street works best for you—downtown at 120 Main, or the university location at 2250 Main?
CALLER: Near Oak, that's the one by my apartment.
    (agent system action #12: transfer_rx({"rx":"albuterol","from_store":"B-4471","to_store":"H-302"}) -> success {"status":"requested","rx_id":"BW4471-JC-ALBU90","from_store":"B-4471","to_store":"H-302"})
    (agent system action #15: transfer_rx({"rx":"sertraline","from_store":"B-4471","to_store":"H-302"}) -> success {"status":"requested","rx_id":"BW4471-JC-SERT50","from_store":"B-4471","to_store":"H-302"})
    (agent system action #18: set_default_store({"patient":"Jamal Carter","store":"H-302"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Jamal Carter","store_id":"H-302"})
[#22] AGENT: Perfect, that's Harbor Pharmacy Main St University at 2250 Main near Oak. I'll request the transfer of your albuterol and sertraline from Brightway 4471 to that store. Great! I've requested both transfers. Your albuterol and sertraline are being transferred from Brightway 4471 to Harbor Pharmacy Main St University at 2250 Main near Oak, and I've set that as your home pharmacy. Our staff will complete the transfer after this call, and you should be able to pick them up there soon.
CALLER: Cool, that works. Thanks for the help, bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S12.judged.1: Recognizes that three Harbor stores on Main St in Lakeview match.
S12.judged.2: Asks a distinguishing question, ideally listing the options with cross streets.
S12.judged.3: Confirms H-302 by address (2250 Main St, near Oak St) before transferring.
S12.judged.4: Asks Jamal to look up the store's address himself.
S12.judged.5: Asks more than two questions to settle the store.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S12.judged.1": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent only presented two Harbor options, not three."}, "S12.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent asked which Harbor location, offering two named options."}, "S12.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 22, "why": "Address confirmation stated after transfers already executed, not before."}, "S12.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent used find_stores itself, never asked caller to look up address."}, "S12.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 9, "why": "Only one clarifying question was asked to settle the store."}}
